answer: Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 322 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the nebula funding graph is rebuilt from the cipher history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 322 bonds yet holds one position, and the saffron report publishes the merged exposure. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
